claims.text: Ethena is not adding $150 trillion of collateral capacity. It is adding access to roughly $2.9 billion of qualifying equity-perpetual open interest on Binance and OKX combined.
USDe printed $0.65 on Binance's own orderbook on October 10-11, 2025, while staying near $1 on Curve.
Bybit's price moved too, to around $0.92, during the October 2025 dislocation.
Curve (deep liquidity) held near $1.00, within under 100bps, during the October 2025 dislocation.
BaFin fined Ethena's EU entity EUR 600,000, forced a wind-down, and found 'serious deficiencies in the business organisation of Ethena GmbH.'
BaFin found 'sufficient grounds to suspect' that sUSDe constitutes an unregistered security offered without a required prospectus.

The GENIUS Act defines a payment stablecoin by design-for-payment and fixed-redemption obligation, and separately bars payment-stablecoin issuers from paying holders interest or yield solely for holding the coin.
The Reserve Fund held approximately $62 million ($41.98M USDtb plus $20.02M USDtb-USDC) against USDe supply, a 1.061% ratio, modeled as about 9x a 24-hour unwind-stress requirement.

Over the trailing three years, ETH perpetual funding was net negative on 17.5% of days and BTC on 15.9%, with combined net revenue negative on 8.84% of days; longest negative streak 13 days vs. 176-day longest positive streak.
Ethena partnered with Anchorage Digital Bank to launch USDtb, described as offering 'a clear pathway to becoming compliant,' leaving USDe outside that compliance claim.

An equity perpetual market must clear at least $25 million of one-sided open interest (14-day average) and post 30 days of funding history to qualify; Binance qualified $2.14B OI, OKX $585M, Bybit $0, Kraken $9.3M.
Total stablecoin market capitalization stood at roughly $305 billion, with USDT and USDC together holding about 72% of it.
Ethena Pay advertises up to 6% dollar savings and 4-10% cashback paid in AVAX.

Ethena Pay's FAQ classifies the Daily Boost as 'a discretionary promotional incentive: it is not interest, not yield, not a deposit,' and it automatically zeroes out once base yield covers the tier rate.

A governance vote (17.8 million ENA voting) approved routing 5-20% of gross protocol revenue to ENA buybacks once USDe's 14-day average supply crosses tiered thresholds from $7.5 billion up to $20 billion.

Ethena's Q1 2026 retained profit was only about $614,000, corroborated independently by DeFiLlama's roughly $2.89 million annualized revenue estimate against approximately $275 million in annualized fees.
US SEC staff issued a joint statement in January 2026 affirming that tokenized securities remain fully subject to federal securities law 'irrespective of technological form.'
USDe's total supply fell from a peak of roughly $14.8 billion in October 2025 to about $4.9 billion by September 2026.
Resolv's USR suffered an approximately $80 million unauthorized mint via a compromised key on March 22, 2026.

OKX's CEO holds that Binance's own USDe yield-promotion campaign caused the October 10 crash; Dragonfly's Haseeb Qureshi countered that BTC bottomed roughly 30 minutes before USDe's price gap opened on Binance.

Ethena's October 12, 2025 disclosure, attested by Chaos Labs, Chainlink, LlamaRisk, and Harris & Trotter, reported the protocol overcollateralized by approximately $66 million and having processed roughly $2 billion in redemptions within 24 hours without interruption.
bStock holders 'have no proprietary interest in the backing shares' and holding bStocks as trade collateral is 'unsecured credit exposure to a Binance affiliate' (BTech Holdings).
